AdminApplyInput.description:
Apply a correction with an optional staff-edited version of its items.
The override changes only what is applied now; the contributor's filing
payload stays byte-for-byte intact, and the audit records both the
effective values and the fact that they were overridden.

AdminCommentEditInput.description:
Staff correction of a public comment's text. The `edited` status marks
the row so readers know it no longer matches what was first posted.

AdminOfficialCorrectionInput.description:
A correction authored by the editorial office itself. It creates its own
ledger row (official: true) so the append-only trail still explains why a
catalog row changed; no contributor filing is required.

AdminReasonInput.description:
Hide/restore share one shape: the reason is mandatory and lands in the
audit trail next to the actor.

AdminRecordEditInput.description:
A full replacement payload for one filing. The edit is re-validated with
the same contract a fresh filing faces (`filings::validate_filing`) —
staff may fix wording, never produce a shape the contributor couldn't.

sequenceId.description:
Public (`spd:sequence:…`) or internal id. When omitted the server
resolves the entity's canonical wild-type sequence - a lookup, not
a computation.

ApiError.description: Validation/authorization failure. Also appears as the envelope's error object.

fields.description: Offending field names (absent when the error is not field-specific)

ApiTokenInput.description:
Mint request for a Universal API Token. A token inherits its creator's
live roles, so there is no scope field: capability changes are made on
the role system, never on the credential.

expiresInDays.description:
Whole days until expiry; omit for a non-expiring token (revocation
and role changes still cut it off instantly).

AppendArtifactsInput.description:
Append evidence files to an existing fold. Creation takes an initial
`artifactIds` list; engines that write outputs asynchronously (trajectories,
final mmCIF) need a way to attach them once the fold already exists.

ArtifactRecord.description: Artifact metadata (storage read). Adds `createdBy`; otherwise identical to FoldArtifactRecord.

completedAt.description: unix seconds; null until the upload completes

shape.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

insertion_site_id.description:
Kept for forward compatibility with wishlist §15.7; recorded in the
construct metadata, not yet interpreted.

AssessmentGetData.description: Current canonical assessment plus full history.

assessment.description: latest assessment; null when none recorded

BiobrickInput.description:
New biobrick part. `categories` mirrors the iGEM Registry's category tags;
`parameters` carries quantitative part metadata (e.g. promoter strength).

BulkInput.description: Batch import for deep mutational scanning (thousands of variants).

CanonicalAssessmentRecord.description: Canonical assessment; `confidenceModel` separates 'manual' declarations from the 'coarse-v1' projection.

evidence.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

CellInput.description:
Unit cell edges and angles as the source states them. Typed (not Value)
so the shape is a 400 at the door, not a junk drawer.

ClaimImportsInput.description:
One-time migration of browser-recorded batch imports (pre-0057). Only
ids the caller already owns are eligible; the server does not trust the
client for anything but the id list.

codon_map.description: Single-species form. Absent for a multi-species snapshot.

genetic_code_table_id.description:
The genetic-code table this snapshot's frequencies are expressed in.
Omitted = the species binding, falling back to the standard code.

map_snapshot_sha256.description:
OPTIONAL and normally absent: the fingerprint is derived from the
codon map(s) by the server (see `map_digest`). A person recording a
table from Kazusa or a paper cannot be expected to compute SHA-256 by
hand, and the dedup key is only trustworthy if it is derived, not
asserted. External pipelines may still send one — it must then equal
the server-derived value, which keeps the ledger honest instead of
silent.

taxon_id.description: Single-species form. Null/absent for a multi-species snapshot.

ComparisonInput.description:
A comparison RESULT computed by an external tool (RMSD, ΔΔG, TM-score, ...)
stored with full method provenance. SPD never computes these itself.

DecisionInput.description:
Formal editorial decision on a validation (0032). `letter` is the author's
decision document; omit it and the curated preset for the decision is
used verbatim.

DeclineInput.description:
Reviewer decline body: a recorded "no" with an optional reason the
editorial office can read when deciding whom to re-ask (0032).

DispatchQuotaInput.description:
Annual dispatch obligation for one organization, set by the editorial
office. 0 is a legitimate value (obligation trivially met); removing the
row returns the org to `unset` (no obligation).

EditorialDecisionRecord.description: One formal editorial decision on a round (0032). `letter` appears only in author/staff reads; the public projection carries the conclusion, round, and date.

editorDisplayName.description: display name when the editor row still exists

editorId.description: null for the 0032 system backfill accepts

letter.description: author decision document; staff/submitter reads only

EditorialMessageInput.description:
One editorial discussion message on a reviewable record. `internal` is
staff-only and requires curator/admin to post; `with_author` (default) is
visible to the submitter too.

EntityRefreshApplyData.description: The applied proposal and the fields that actually changed. The record itself is re-read by the caller.

EntityRefreshField.description: One proposed upstream change. `old` is the stored projection, `new` the live source's value; protected fields are shown but the apply door refuses them.

new.description: complete JSON value from the fetched record

old.description: complete JSON value from the stored row

EntityRefreshProposal.description: A stored upstream refresh proposal. `id` is the public `spd:refresh:…` id.

EntityRefreshSource.description: The upstream address behind an imported record, plus live staleness arithmetic. `fetchedAt` is the last applied refresh or the record's own source plate; it is null when neither exists.

externalId.description: the upstream id the source was read by

sourceUpdatedAt.description: the source's own last-revision stamp when known

EntitySourceRefreshData.description: Source freshness and the current pending proposal for one imported record.

proposal.description: null when no proposal is pending

Envelope.description: Success envelope used by most reads/lists: { data, meta: { schemaVersion, ... }, error: null }. Creation/dedup receipt endpoints return a bare object instead (documented per operation).

data.description: Payload — the resource object or array the endpoint returns; per-operation summary names it.

error.description: null on success; { code, message, fields } on a validation failure (which also mirrors the 400 body).

meta.description: Response metadata; always carries schemaVersion, plus count/page fields on list endpoints.

normalization.description:
Declared in the published environment schema; stored verbatim in
`normalization_json`. Excluded from `environment_sha256` on purpose
(identity = the physical state; normalization is processing notes).

customProtonation.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

normalization.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

solvent.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

proteinId.description:
Explicit assertion that this biocatalyst IS a catalog protein record
— never inferred, only claimed (FEATURE_LIST §54).

ExternalIdentifierInput.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/entities/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/external-ids.

`url` is optional: a known source gets its canonical public route when
omitted. `primary` marks the preferred address for the entity/source pair;
it is a label, not a uniqueness rule (the natural keys already make one
upstream id single-valued).

ExternalReferenceInput.description:
Cross-references were an unvalidated `Vec<Value>` until round 9: the
shape is now pinned (and `deny_unknown_fields` catches the FE wizard's
historical `id` vs `externalId` drift at the door, not in storage).

FeatureLabelUpdate.description:
Update is intentionally partial and key-free: `scope` and `key` are the
record-facing identity, and renaming them would orphan every row that
already stores the key. Delete is expressed as `status: "deprecated"`.

FoldArtifactRecord.description: Artifact metadata as served under a fold.

completedAt.description: unix seconds; null until the upload completes

shape.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

FoldHistoryData.description: Everything attached to a fold in one view.

prediction.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

FoldRecord.description: Predicted fold. Computation submissions are schema-validated and published immediately — `verificationLevel` is always "unverified". `validationStatus`/`canonicalEvidenceStatus` are derived live from wet-lab evidence, never stored lifecycle columns.

artifactIds.description: JSON array of artifact public ids parsed from the stored column.

canonicalEvidenceStatus.description: latest canonical assessment status; absent when no assessment exists

derivedMetrics.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

prediction.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

runtimeMetadata.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

GeneInput.description:
A gene record as asserted by a contributor. The record SELF-CARRIES its
sequences: `dnaSequence` and `rnaSequence` are optional statements of
what the gene's DNA and its transcript are; regions later anchor to
whichever of them exists (FEATURE_LIST §55).

NOT deny-unknown by design — like every record-level input whose own
projection must survive a corrections merge (§53), it ignores keys it
does not own (`id`, `dnaLength`, …).

GeneRefreshApplyData.description: The updated gene projection and the proposal marked applied.

gene.description: the gene read projection after the applied fields were written

GeneRefreshApplyInput.description: Request body of the apply door: the safe field names the human selected.

GeneRefreshField.description: One proposed change. `old` is the stored projection, `new` the fetched record's value; protected fields are shown but the apply door refuses them.

new.description: complete JSON value from the fetched record

old.description: complete JSON value from the stored row

GeneRefreshProposal.description: A stored refresh proposal. `id` is the public `spd:refresh:…` id.

GeneRegionInput.description:
One asserted DNA/RNA region of a gene. Positions are 1-based inclusive
and may stay open (null = "somewhere", the annotation-table convention);
`proteinId` is the §54 assertion, legal only on a CDS row (either
molecule: a genomic import has no transcript to hang it from).

GeneRegionQualifierInput.description:
One GenBank qualifier, kept in file order (duplicates included): the
evidence list is an assertion of what the source wrote, so it is neither
sorted nor de-duplicated.

GeneSourceRefreshData.description: Staleness and the current pending proposal for one gene.

proposal.description: null when no proposal is pending

GeneSourceRefreshSource.description: Stored upstream source plate plus live staleness arithmetic. `ageDays` is derived from `fetchedAt` and is null when the record was never fetched.

accession.description: bare accession, null when the gene has none

accessionVersion.description: versioned accession, null when the gene has none

codonToAa.description:
All 64 DNA codons, each mapped to one amino-acid letter (`*` = stop).
NCBI tables 2 and 31 use `U` (selenocysteine) and `O` (pyrrolysine).

GraphQueryInput.description:
Exactly one of `root` / `roots` (batch, max 25 — the whole batch shares
one resolution budget).

ImportInput.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/external/import. The upstream id is required; the
handler trims it and applies the per-source format gate.

InteractionInput.description:
A protein-protein interaction / complex between two folds. Binding sites
are community-annotated residue-site descriptors (curation metadata).

ManualDispatchInput.description:
Editorial-office hand dispatch for one record when the automatic
round-robin came up short (or a reviewer's seat later collapsed).
`entityId` is the internal id exactly as the admin queue shows it.
`dueDays` optionally overrides the standard work window (1..=90).

MaterialLinkInput.description:
Polymorphic link: a material (strain/cell line) used by a validation,
construct, or sequence.

artifactIds.description: JSON array of artifact public ids parsed from the stored column.

engine.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

request.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

result.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

MeasurementInput.description:
One quantitative measurement. `value` is `{value, unit, error?, replicates?}`
(structured so industry screens can filter on it); `ligand` is a small
inline descriptor `{name, identifier, ...}` — SPD deliberately stores no
standalone ligand/SMILES database.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

trainedHeads.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

MutationEffectInput.description:
One effect record on a background sequence. Single-position mutations are
one-element arrays; multi-position records carry an optional
`interaction_term` (deviation from additive expectation = epistasis).

MutationTreeData.description: Mutation tree rooted at the requested sequence.

MutationTreeNode.description: Descendant-tree node with depth from the requested root.

mutations.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

NodeQuery.description:
One node of a graph query: which fields to keep and which edges to walk.
`expand` keys are edge names from the registry (`GET`-style discovery is
the openapi description + the 400 error message, which lists the legal
edges for the offending node). BTreeMap keeps traversal order
deterministic — same input, same output, no hash-order leaks.

limit.description: For list edges: children to keep (default 20, max 100).

NominateInput.description:
Nomination of one of the organization's active researchers into its peer
pool. Addressed by ORCID i: the org roster (GET /organizations/{id}
members) shows ORCIDs, and nomination requires the nominee to have
completed the researcher application anyway.

ObservedStructureRecord.description: Experimentally observed structure attached to a fold.

comparison.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

coverage.description: declared fraction of the reference covered, 0..1; null when unasserted

environment.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

quality.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

resolutionAngstrom.description: declared by the observer, stored as stated; null for rows predating assertions

rmsdToReference.description: declared RMSD in angstroms — SPD never computes it; null when unasserted

source.description: External pathway references (KEGG map id, MetaCyc, ...).

species.description:
Reactome's upstream plate. Every member is optional: a curated SPD
pathway states none of them, and an import states only what Reactome
actually asserted.

topology.description:
SPD-owned diagram (`spd-pathway-topology/1`). Imported pathways get
it from their upstream document; native pathways may submit one.

PdbEntityInput.description:
One RCSB entity row, quoted. `sequence` is the SOURCE-VERBATIM one-letter
code — `(MSE)` and `X` survive exactly as published, because normalizing
here would be SPD editing the catalog. The bookkeeping sha (over the
stripped/uppercased bytes) is what chain↔sequence reconciliation matches
on; the link only exists on exact equality.

PdbEntryInput.description:
One PDB entry as the RCSB describes it. `metadata` is a client-shaped
projection of the source document (SPD stores, never re-derives — the
full authoritative payload belongs to a provenance snapshot);
`sourceUpdatedAt` is the source's own revision moment when the importer
knows it.

coordinatesArtifactId.description:
Completed `full_structure_*` artifact carrying the coordinate file
this row describes (uploaded via the presigned pipeline).

entities.description:
Absent (null) = leave the entity table untouched. Present = this list
IS the entry's entity set and replaces it wholesale — the §44
shadow-catalog exemption, and the only place in SPD where a batch
DELETE is honest.

artifactIds.description: JSON array of artifact public ids parsed from the stored column.

features.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

method.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

massDalton.description:
Only a source-provided experimental mass belongs here. UniProt's
sequence object carries length/md5/crc64 but NO mass, so the seeder
never fills this; NULL means "the source did not assert one".

ProteinLinkInput.description:
Body of the enzyme→protein link sub-resource (both enzyme catalogs).
The link is a single assertion, not a row edit: binding never re-validates
the other fields, which is what the corrections channel (§53) is for.

taxId.description: NCBI tax id; null when unknown

ProteinRecord.description: Protein entity read projection. `id` is the public `spd:protein:…` id.

altNames.description: string array parsed from the stored column

comments.description: [{type,texts[],evidence[]}] array parsed from the stored column

entryName.description: UniProt short entry name when asserted

externalReferences.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

geneSynonyms.description: string array parsed from the stored column

keywords.description: [{id?,name}] array parsed from the stored column

massDalton.description: source-asserted mass; never computed by SPD

orfNames.description: string array parsed from the stored column

organismLineage.description: [{rank,value}] array parsed from the stored column

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

tags.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

ProtocolInput.description:
New or revised protocol content. `steps` is an ordered array of
`{step, duration?, notes?}` objects; `reagents` references reagent
public ids (`{id, role?}`); `targets` references applicable SPD entities
(`{entityType, entityId}`). All arrays fall back to `[]` when omitted.

ProtocolReviewEditInput.description:
Staff content edit of a protocol review's comments. Decision and status
stay untouched; the action is recorded in the audit trail (protocol
reviews have no moderation-events table — same stance as moderate).

confidentialComment.description:
Editor-only note ("comments for the editor", OJS). Never appears in
any public projection; staff reads only.

pubchemSections.description:
PUG-View section tree, normalized to headings/descriptions/text
values. Only the importer sets it; the contributor wizard leaves it
empty.

citation.description: Optional per-row citation override; otherwise the fixed REBASE paper.

RelationInput.description:
A manual cross-module assertion. The path entity is the from-side, so a
client never sends `fromType`/`fromId` — a mismatched body cannot claim
to write a different subject than the one it addressed.

metadata.description: Small non-queryable extras; must be a JSON object when present.

role.description: Disambiguates repeated relation types between the same pair.

RemovePeerInput.description: Body for the DELETE-with-body removal style already used by role revoke.

ResolveProteinInput.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/external/resolve-protein. A region row may store the
upstream protein accession (`NP_033894.3`) without an SPD protein link;
this door resolves it to a local protein, importing the UniProt record
behind it when the ledger has none.

proteinId.description:
Explicit assertion that this record IS (the protein of) a catalog
protein record — never inferred, only claimed (FEATURE_LIST §54).

targetMolecule.description:
What this cutter acts on: 'dna', 'rna' or 'other' (FEATURE_LIST §56;
absent means 'dna', the truth of every legacy row). An RNA cutter's
recognition letters may include U — the site gate already allows
any ASCII alphabetic.

confidentialComment.description:
Editor-only note ("comments for the editor", OJS). Never appears in
any public projection; staff reads only.

ReviewListData.description: Published and unpublished reviews with a live consensus tally.

ReviewRecord.description: Peer review of a screened validation. `round` (0032) groups reviews into review rounds; `confidentialComment` appears ONLY in staff/owner reads of the same record.

criteria.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

payload.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

source.description:
Upstream catalog for a root whose `id` is not an SPD public id.
Today only `uniprot` can become a graph node (a protein, with the
sequence the importer stores beside it). When omitted, an id shaped
like a UniProt accession is resolved through UniProt automatically;
an SPD `spd:…` id never goes upstream.

RootRef.description:
A fetch target: entity type + record id (internal uuid or public
`spd:` id both resolve, same as every other read).

SequenceMutationAnnotation.description: One feature row overlapping a declared mutation position.

SequenceMutationMapData.description: Declared mutations joined to annotations, effects, and exact-match structures.

annotated.description: true when the sequence has any feature rows

structureAvailable.description: true when an exact-match PDB entity exists

SequenceMutationMapping.description: One declared mutation joined to overlapping annotations, measured effects, and exact-match structure availability.

effectClass.description: first recorded effect at this position; null when none

inStructure.description: true only when an exact-match PDB entity exists

SequenceMutationStructure.description: One exact-match PDB entity, projected for the mutation map. Candidate structures are excluded.

SequenceRecord.description: Immutable sequence record. `proteinId`/`parentSequenceId` are public spd: ids (null when unresolvable).

mutations.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

proteinId.description: owning protein public id; null when unresolvable

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

tags.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

SequenceStabilityDomainData.description: Latest engine stability scan across the sequence's folds.

foldId.description: owning fold public id; null when no scan

stabilityDomain.description: latest scan; null when none recorded

SequenceStructureCandidate.description: One candidate PDB chain grounded in a shared UniProt accession. Never an identity claim.

coordinatesArtifactId.description: null when no coordinate file was stored

coverage.description: residueCount / sequence length, clamped 0..1; null when either is missing

identity.description: always null: no sequence identity is claimed

note.description: human note supplied with the decision

SequenceStructureCandidatesData.description: Candidate PDB chains for a sequence plus the persisted human decision.

SequenceStructureEntry.description: The PDB entry facts around one exact sequence match.

coordinatesArtifactId.description: null when no coordinate file was stored

SequenceStructureMatch.description: One exact sequence match between an SPD sequence and a PDB entity.

SequenceStructuresData.description: Exact-match PDB structures for a sequence, in primary-structure order.

expiresAt.description: unix seconds; null for roles without expiry

SessionUser.description: Authenticated user record. `id` is the addressable user id (UUID; ORCID also accepted by user-addressed endpoints).

displayName.description: null when the ORCID record carries no name

SnapshotInput.description:
One raw external payload attached to one entity. `content` is stored
re-serialized compactly (the ledger's sha256 covers the stored bytes);
`source`/`source_id` stay human-addressable so the live truth can always
be re-fetched upstream.

fetchedAt.description:
unix seconds of the upstream fetch (client-attested moment the
payload entered SPD's view; sanity-bounded, see service).

mediaType.description:
Defaults to `application/json`. Only the whitelist in `service` is
accepted — provenance payloads are text documents, not binaries.

SpeciesDataInput.description:
One researcher-contributed organism assertion. `fields` is a flat map of
human field names to values; the server normalizes it into the same
`data_json` shape the species-data panel already reads.

stabilityDomain.description: latest scan; null when none recorded

grid.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

points.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

summary.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

StepInput.description:
One step of the enzyme-reaction-pathway triple: a reaction at `step_order`,
optionally catalyzed by a specific enzyme.

StructureCandidateDecisionInput.description:
A human verdict on one candidate chain. The decision vocabulary is
mirrored by the Rust `STRUCTURE_DECISIONS` gate and the 0050 CHECK; the
note is bounded so a stray payload cannot bloat the row.

SupplierInput.description:
Shared by vector-template and restriction-enzyme supplier endpoints.
`attributes` is free-form JSON the listing organization can use to expose
extra properties (e.g. purity, packaging); `description` is a short intro.

TokenTierInput.description:
Admin-only tier grant for the graph-query metering (FEATURE_LIST §41).
Mint always issues `standard`; this is the ENTITLEMENT door (payment is
settled out of band until a billing channel exists), hence admin-gated.

ValidationDigest.description: Wet-lab validation as listed under a fold (no target/license columns).

artifactIds.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

assay.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

interpretation.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

observations.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

ValidationGetData.description: Validation with its screening history, reviews, and (0032) the decision ledger for the record's rounds.

ValidationRecord.description: Wet-lab validation. `id` is the row uuid by design (no separate public id column).

artifactIds.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

assay.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

interpretation.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

observations.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

provenance.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

targetEnvironment.description: Free-form JSON parsed from the stored column.

ValidationReviewEditInput.description:
Staff correction of a review's comment text. Decision and status are
NOT touched here — invalidate/restore are those levers; this fixes
wording only, and the edit is recorded as an 'edited' moderation event.

VectorLinkInput.description: Link an existing vector template to a biobrick (junction row).

WikiInput.description:
Create-or-update payload for an entry wiki. `changeSummary` is the edit
reason recorded on every revision (the PDB "why updated" analog).

bearerAuth.description: Universal API Token (`Authorization: Bearer spd_...`), minted at POST /api/v1/user/me/api-tokens. Resolves to the minting user; roles are read live per request.

cookieAuth.description: Session cookie issued by the ORCID login flow.
cookieAuth.name: spd_session

info.description: SPD stores, validates and retrieves protein records; it never computes science (folding, MD and uncertainty live in SPICE workers). Two trust tiers: wet-lab evidence passes human screening; computation submissions are schema-validated and published immediately, labeled verificationLevel "unverified". Request bodies are camelCase; responses expose public spd: ids only.
